* Buyback: release the bar's NFC card and carry its serial into stock (D214179 fix)

Ordinary buybacks created the stock row but never released the bar's card, so it
stayed 'assigned' to the seller and packing refused it for the next buyer. Same
rule as the vault path: release only when the line sells back every card still
assigned to the order item. Data fix for D214179 (buyback 952ffe2a).

(+ S$0.40/g, folded into each premium as on 16 Oct; the supplier-level spread stays 0
because it would also hit the all-in StoneX-indexed Nadir/Valcambi/Maple/Argor terms).

* Packing screen: show the manufacturer serial for a whole curve bar (5 g Nadir)

The counterpart chip showed a parent-bar serial for every non-standard line, so a
curve-priced WHOLE bar (no parent) showed nothing although its card carries the
bar's serial. One pure rule (serialCounterpart) + tests.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USEP33woPpzu9b9BYFktY

* Dispatch screen grouped by next step: Needs attention / To pack / Ready to hand over / Out for delivery / Done today

Mukesh 20 Nov: packed orders kept appearing among untouched ones because the
screen was grouped by courier. Each order now sits in exactly one stage
(lib/admin/dispatch-stages.ts, pure + tested); the existing courier sections
render inside each stage with that stage's share of their list, so every card,
gate and booking action is unchanged. Rows sort by deadline (promised window,
else order time); courier/channel chip on every row; collapsible stages
remembered per device; summary chips; Done today (collapsed). Mobile-first.

* Brand icons on Dispatch + Shippers: order channel (website/app, Lazada, TikTok, Shopee) and courier (Lalamove, SPX, Grab, SingPost)

Each brand's own mark (its site's icon or the simple-icons set; our app icon for
the website), 64 px WebP in public/images/brands. channelIconKey / courierIconKey
are pure + tested; BrandIcon renders on a white badge so dark marks stay visible.
A marketplace order's chip now names the carrier (e.g. SpeedPost) instead of
repeating the marketplace.

- Chips enlarged to read like the payment logos: channel 40, courier 30, Shippers 44; thinner margin.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USEP33woPpzu9b9BYFktY

* Notify me for sold-out shop items (+ presale), and Dispatch split into Today / Tomorrow / Later

Notify me (Mukesh 2026-11-20, his picks: signed-in only, presale also fires, sold-out always shown):
- stock_alerts table (20261120d, service-role only); /api/account/stock-alerts GET/POST/DELETE;
  stock-alerts cron (*/15) claims each open alert then sends once when the product is back in
  stock or open for pre-order: email + push now, WhatsApp once 1p1g_stock_alert_v1 is approved
  (submit/poll scripts added; TEMPLATE_STOCK_ALERT null until then).
- Shop: sold-out products always listed, last in each section (soldOutLast, shared kernel), with
  a Notify me button on tile, row and accessory cards; signed-out taps go via sign-in and set the
  alert on return (?notify=). Show sold-out tick box removed (MAG sold-out bars stay hidden).
- App: Notify me node + showSoldOut default true via the spec (no build); sorted-last needs the
  next build (engine.js rebuilt). Port diff: contract §252.
- Account: Your alerts card with Remove. Admin products: "N waiting" chip.

Dispatch: each stage splits into Today / Tomorrow / Later under dated headers (Singapore day of
the promised window; no window = today; a passed window is late, still today), and each row
carries a Today / Tomorrow / date chip, so a 21 Nov order no longer reads as missed today.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USEP33woPpzu9b9BYFktY

* Dispatch: separate Picked up · in transit from Out for delivery; remove the SPX Pickup Slots tile

- New stage in_transit: picked up / moving through the carrier's network (SPX, NinjaVan, a
  marketplace carrier). Out for delivery = the carrier's out_for_delivery, or a direct driver
  (Lalamove, evening run, Grab) who has the parcel. Both collapsed by default, no day split.
- SPX Pickup Slots tile removed (Mukesh: not used), with its only consumer route
  /api/spx/pickup-times and that route's test. Architecture doc: 666 routes.
- twilio.ts: record the submitted 1p1g_stock_alert_v1 SID (still null until Meta approves).

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USEP33woPpzu9b9BYFktY

* Notify me: switch on WhatsApp — 1p1g_stock_alert_v1 Meta-approved (UTILITY, 2026-11-20)

TEMPLATE_STOCK_ALERT = HX1324c345f143bc02266fa91e8aced199 (submitted run 44734258078, approved
per poll run 44766130701). Stock alerts now go by WhatsApp + email + push. Test pins the
template's variables ({{1}} first name, {{2}} product, {{3}} state line).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USEP33woPpzu9b9BYFktY

* Marketplace: act on a buyer's cancel request, and wait 15 minutes before auto-dispatch

Lazada 176203723521250 (our 740ECC5F, S$5,141.70) was packed + ready-to-ship 9 s after payment;
the buyer asked to cancel 22 s later. Lazada sent that as a reverse-order push (message_type 10,
CANCEL_INIT) while the order stayed ready_to_ship, so the 'canceled' issue never fired and the
webhook ignored type 10. Mukesh 20 Nov: options 1 + 2.

1. Cancel request (lib/marketplace/cancel-request.ts, migration 20261120e): a signed reverse push
   with CANCEL_* opens a 'cancel_requested' issue on the import row -> one escalate Control Tower
   card + one WhatsApp; the order goes to Dispatch -> Needs attention with a red chip; packing,
   booking and Lazada/TikTok arrange are blocked (dispatchBlocker + both fulfil routes). A
   rejected/withdrawn request resolves it; a completed one becomes 'canceled'; cancelling our
   order closes it. Nothing is cancelled automatically.
2. Auto-dispatch grace: an order is arranged only once it has been ours for 15 minutes
   (pastDispatchGrace); unknown age waits.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USEP33woPpzu9b9BYFktY

* Register the 6 agents whose Control Tower cards were silently dropped (FK to ai_agents)

agent_decisions.agent_name references ai_agents(name). lazada_sync, tiktok_shop_sync,
lazada_auto_dispatch, tiktok_shop_auto_dispatch, tiktok_connection and order_cancel_teardown
were never registered, so every card insert failed with an FK violation that runMonitor /
fileEscalation only log. No marketplace import card (unknown SKU, cancelled, returned, cancel
requested), auto-dispatch escalation, TikTok connection card or cancel-teardown card had ever
reached Control Tower. Found checking Lazada 176203723521250's cancel-request card (20 Nov).

Migration 20261120f registers them; agent-names-registered.test.ts reads every agentName in
src and fails if a migration does not register it (mutation-checked: removing the migration
lists all six).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USEP33woPpzu9b9BYFktY

---------
